facts.text: The three first partner Pokémon are Browt, the Bean Chick Pokémon (Grass type); Pombon, the Puppy Pokémon (Fire type); and Gecqua, the Water Gecko Pokémon (Water type).
Their abilities are Overgrow (Browt), Blaze (Pombon) and Torrent (Gecqua).
Pokémon Winds and Pokémon Waves will be released exclusively on Nintendo Switch 2 in a simultaneous worldwide release in 2027.
The games feature an open world with windswept islands and a vast ocean to explore.
